description: Canonical W15-A8 visual target registry: every PNG in Images-GUI/ maps to at least one target. Collage PNGs expand into a parent + N region children. The 09-themes palette reference additionally expands into 6 theme-variant siblings. Per-target viewport reflects the actual PNG dimensions (1672x941 and 1586x992 outliers are explicit overrides on top of the 1536x1024 default).
